info.name: Ticky CRM
info.summary: Open-source CRM and client management for Nextcloud
info.description:
Ticky CRM is an **open-source CRM for Nextcloud**. Manage your customers, keep track of interactions, and organize follow-ups directly in your Nextcloud.
## Features
- **Customer management:** Manage companies and individual customers with contact and billing details. - **Customer notes:** Keep customer information and notes in one place. - **Contacts integration:** Connect customers with contacts in Nextcloud. - **Products:** Manage your product catalog and assign products to customers. - **Contact status and follow-ups:** See who needs attention with visual status icons, configurable intervals, and manual overrides. - **Activity tracking:** View recorded changes in the customer timeline.
## Planned features
- File integration - Deck integration - Helpdesk - Quotes
## Development and feedback
**Ticky CRM is in early development.** Features and workflows are still evolving.
Feedback, ideas, and contributions are welcome. Visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/IdentSpace/ticky_crm) or [report an issue](https://github.com/IdentSpace/ticky_crm/issues).
